# SidePanel — Cobalt source template

<!-- Generated by tools/content.mjs from MDX and source; do not edit. -->

The default and `form` variants retain a row title container. The opt-in `participants` variant keeps its column title/subtitle container and dedicated spacing and typography; restoring the default layout does not change it.
